title: Takaful Claims Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily contribution and claims activity from a fictional Indonesian takaful operator into claims KPIs, 7-day investigation-referral risk scores, claim document rejection anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Claims per 1,000 contributions, claims, escalations to claims investigation and the IDR value of contributions received for 40 takaful plans in Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan and Makassar.
The plans cover five product lines: health, motor, family, property and SME takaful. Contributions go to the participants' risk fund, from which claims are paid.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to plan-day rows.
The claim-cause chart shows which causes are referred to investigation and which always settle directly, such as the two city-wide flood events.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of claims KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which plans should the claims team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each plan's probability of a claim being referred to investigation in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags claim document rejection rate outliers per plan, and the forecast projects operator-wide claims volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Claims file audit compliance, claim file coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Claims file audit compliance against escalated claims by plan shows where missed audits and referrals move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, plan, claim-cause and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a claim is referred right now?

talking_points: Live claim events land in RAW.LIVE_CLAIMS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs REFERRED claims with an SOP hint and the plan's current risk band, then emails the on-call claims officer.
tabs.call_out: From referred claim to case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic claims-handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited. The SOPs are operational only and make no Sharia or regulatory rulings.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
